ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale — the two models are near-identical on serving cost, latency, and context. For this clean, well-defined math problem I leaned on (1) Avocet's marginally higher reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 75.9 vs 74.8, GPQA 56.2 vs 54.3), and (2) the fact that bounded, clearly-specified problems are exactly Avocet's self-reported top-preferred task family. Note these benchmark gaps are small and the task-preference signal doesn't actually predict output quality, so it's a weak tiebreak — but with nothing else distinguishing them, it tipped toward Avocet.
